tokens: node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css (Tailwind v4 defaults the app's utilities resolve to)

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background (body), cards, inputs, secondary pill buttons. Also the text colour on emerald-600 / slate-900 fills. Dark: slate-950 — page ground and cards; text on emerald-400 buttons and on the (light) provider panel.

tokens.name: slate-50
tokens.usage: Footer band, search field at rest, plan-step rows and checklist pills. Dark: slate-900 — footer band, search field, list rows.

tokens.name: slate-100
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost nav links; hairline border on plan-step rows; neutral badge fallback. Dark: slate-800 — ghost hover fill, row hairlines.

tokens.name: slate-200
tokens.usage: THE hairline: card, input, header and footer borders; stat dividers. Light body copy on slate-900 panels. Dark: slate-700 — hairlines (decorative, like light's); panel body copy reads as slate-700 on slate-50.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Hover border on secondary pill buttons; dashed empty-state border. Body copy on slate-900 panels. Dark: slate-600 — hover borders, dashed empty state; panel copy on slate-50 (≈7:1).

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Search icon and the tiny uppercase price label on cards. About 2.6:1 on white — below 4.5:1; kept exact from the source, use only for icons or non-essential labels. Dark: unchanged — here it passes (≈7:1 on slate-950), so price labels are legible.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Muted text on white and slate-50: subtitles, card meta, footer links, section intros (≈4.8:1 on white). Dark: slate-400 — muted text (≈7:1 on slate-950, ≈6:1 on slate-900).

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white: nav links, category sub-links, chip text. Dark: slate-300 — secondary text.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Form control text and secondary-button labels on white. Dark: slate-200 — form text, secondary button labels.

tokens.name: slate-900

tokens.name: ink

tokens.name: emerald-400

tokens.name: emerald-500
tokens.usage: Input focus border; primary button fill on slate-900 panels; start of the hero 'Grow.' gradient. White text on it is ≈2.5:1 — kept from the source, flagged. Dark: emerald-400 — focus border; panel button fill with slate-950 text.

tokens.name: emerald-600
tokens.usage: THE brand colour: primary pill buttons, logo tile, step numbers, check icons, focus outlines. White text on it is ≈3.7:1 — passes only for 24px+/bold 19px+ text; kept exact from the source, flagged. Dark: emerald-400 — the action fill; its `white` label becomes slate-950 (≈9:1), fixing the light theme's contrast flag.
